frequency_question: How often does the Ministry of Heavy Industries successfully notify and implement a major commercial vehicle promotion scheme within a comparable 12-month policy window?
membership_rule: Includes central government schemes explicitly targeting commercial vehicle adoption or manufacturing incentives with outlay > 50 billion INR. Excludes routine customs duty adjustments or state-level policies.

cases.name: FAME-II Scheme (Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Hybrid and Electric Vehicles)
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; universe of major overarching national EV/auto industrial schemes in this timeframe is effectively exhaustive.
known_gaps: Smaller sub-schemes or pilot projects with lower financial outlays are excluded.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 3 major attempted large-scale EV/Auto policy rollouts by the Ministry
validity_reason: Policy momentum and bureaucratic framework for green mobility remain consistent under the current administration.
